# Test fixtures

Generated by the development-only scripts in `tools/fixtures/` with the
pinned Python environment in `tools/fixtures/pyproject.toml` / `uv.lock`,
then copied here by `tools/fixtures/sync_fixtures.py` (Zarr stores zipped).
R code never runs Python to read them.

This package ships `gex_airr.h5mu`, `gex_airr_v{2,3}.zarr.zip`,
`expected_airr.json` and `manifest.json`. The raw outputs of every generator
live in `tools/fixtures/generated/`.

| Directory | Script | Contents |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `generated/scirpy/` | `generate_scirpy_fixtures.py` | `airr.h5ad`, `airr_v{2,3}.zarr` (scirpy AIRR AnnData); `gex_airr.h5mu`, `gex_airr_v{2,3}.zarr` (axis-0 MuData: GEX + AIRR, partially overlapping cells); `expected_airr.json` (Python's view of the data); `manifest.json` (package versions and the exact Awkward `form` JSON of every element) |
| `generated/awkward/` | `generate_awkward_edge_fixtures.py` | `edge_cases.h5ad`, `edge_cases_v{2,3}.zarr` (BitMasked, ByteMasked, Unmasked, Regular, tuple and nested records, empty vs missing strings and lists); `union.h5ad` (an unsupported `UnionArray`); `expected_edge_cases.json` |

The AIRR cells cover zero chains (`c0`), a single chain, an alpha/beta pair,
multichain (3 TRA + 2 TRB), BCR heavy + kappa and lambda, a non-productive
chain, missing fields and an extra non-standard field (`my_score`). scirpy
normalises empty strings to missing values, which is why the scirpy fixture
has no empty strings; `awkward/edge_cases` covers them.

Versions used: mudata 0.4.1, anndata 0.13.4, scirpy 0.25.1, awkward 2.14.0,
zarr 3.4.2, h5py 3.16.0, numpy 2.5.4, pandas 3.1.0.

Regenerate (from `tools/fixtures`):

```sh
uv sync
.venv/bin/python -I generate_scirpy_fixtures.py
.venv/bin/python -I generate_awkward_edge_fixtures.py
.venv/bin/python -I generate_mudata_fixtures.py ../../tests/testthat/fixtures/expected_update.json
.venv/bin/python -I sync_fixtures.py ../../../anndataR   # path to the anndataR checkout
```

`sync_fixtures.py` also copies `airr*`, `gex_airr.h5mu`, `edge_cases*` and
`union.h5ad` into the anndataR patch under `tests/testthat/fixtures/awkward/`.
